DELIBERATELY UNPOPULATED. Every value below is the placeholder
the build while any remain. That failure is correct behaviour, not a bug.
WHY AN AGENT MUST NOT FILL THIS IN
This number is rendered on a screen shown to someone who may be having a
heart attack, and it is the primary action on it. A number that is wrong,
out of service, or right for one state and wrong for another is the single
most damaging defect this application can ship — the user does exactly what
the app told them and reaches nobody.
PRD §14 lists this as an open item precisely because emergency numbers vary
by state in Nigeria and 112 coverage is uneven. It has to be confirmed by a
person who has dialled it, per state, and recorded who checked and when.
Replace each REQUIRES_HUMAN_VERIFICATION with a dialable number, then fill
in verifiedBy and verifiedAt. Add a stateOverrides entry only for states
where the national number does not reach a working dispatcher.
